decision: remote.run reads stdout and stderr from the channel in one loop with a combined 16 MiB cap and a total deadline of timeout seconds
why: reading stdout to EOF then stderr lets a flood or a trickle run forever; one loop checks the cap and the deadline every pass

decision: get_file streams sftp.open().read() to disk with a byte counter instead of sftp.get
why: sftp.get and getfo prefetch the size the target's stat claims, so a lying stat can queue unbounded reads; counting bytes stops at the cap mid-transfer
